user.title: Set up room
user.description: Pick the window sensors and thermostats of one room. Create one entry per room.

data.name: Room name
data.outdoor_max_temp: Only act when outside is colder than (°C)
data.notify_service: Notify actions (pick list like in Developer Tools)
data.notify_after: Remind after X minutes open (0 = off)
data.heat_power_kw: Fixed gas power of the room (kW, only without room area)
data.room_area: Room area for the gas calculation (m², 0 = fixed power)

data_description.heating_entity: Pick an entity that shows whether heating is running (e.g. a climate device, switch or summer-mode toggle). If it has one of the states below, nothing is controlled and only the window alert stays active. Example: off, or for a summer-mode switch: on.
data_description.heat_power_kw: Only used if the room area below is 0, and for older days before version 1.4.2. Rough estimate of the room's average gas power, e.g. 1.0 kW.
data_description.gas_kwh_per_m3: Conversion from kWh to m³ of gas. It is on your gas bill (calorific value times conversion factor), usually about 10.
data_description.notify_service: Pick one or more notify actions from the list, e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone. You can also type to search or enter a custom name.
data_description.room_area: If greater than 0, the room's heating power is calculated from area, heat load and outdoor temperature instead of the fixed power above.
data_description.heat_load_w_m2: Heat load per m² at design temperature. Rough values: new build about 40, renovated about 60, unrenovated old building about 100.
data_description.design_temp: Standard design outdoor temperature of your location. Without an outdoor sensor, half power is assumed.
data_description.notify_message: Text of the reminder, like the “Message” field in Developer Tools. Placeholders: {raum}, {minuten} and {fenster} (names of the open windows).
data_description.notify_title: Optional title. The same placeholders work, e.g. Window open: {raum}.
